inspection_scope: Release/schema audit only: row counts, lexical sign presence, field missingness and first record. No P-value ranking, locus definition, effect estimation or statistical testing performed.
metadata_lines: # Description:	Genome-wide association meta-analysis; included the COPDGene study, the UK Biobank, and the following ICGC cohorts: ARIC - Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities Study, Cardiovascular Health Study (African and European ancestries), ECLIPSE - Evaluation of COPD Longitudinally to Identify Predictive Surrogate End-points, EOCOPD and ICGN - Boston Early-Onset COPD Study and International COPD Genetics Network, Lung Expression Quantitative Trait Loci Study, Framingham Heart Study, KARE - Korean Association Resource project, Transcontinental COPD Genetics Study, Korea, Lifelines, Lovelace, MESA - Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (African, European, and Hispanic ancestries), NETT/NAS - National Emphysema Treatment Trial / Normative Aging Study, GenKOLS - Bergen, Norway COPD Cohort, Transcontinental COPD Genetics Study, Poland, Rotterdam Study (1, 2 and 3), and SPIROMICS - Subpopulations and intermediate outcome measures in COPD study.

# Method:	Logistic regression, with COPD as outcome, was performed in individual cohorts, checked for orientation and hg19 chr and positions. Summary statistics for each cohort were further assessed using EasyQC. Then, a fixed-effects meta-analysis was performed using METAL. Variants from the meta-analysis were only further examined if they were present in the UK Biobank as well as at least 11 ICGC studies.
reason: Small public result/display export, not complete tested-variant release; effect dictionary explicitly absolute, so valid signed effects unavailable. No direction is reconstructed from coded/minor/display alleles.

metadata_lines: # Description:	Genome-wide association meta-analysis. Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) affection status (binary) was the outcome of interest with case status defined using pre-bronchodilator spirometry values. Cases had forced expiratory volume in 1 second (FEV1)   80% and FEV1/FVC > 0.7.

# Method:	Logistic regression was performed in individual cohorts, checked for orientation and hg19 chr and positions. Summary statistics for each cohort were further assessed using EasyQC. Then, a fixed-effects meta-analysis was performed using METAL.  Analysis includes subjects with both genome-wide and custom genotyping.
